what: Gilead Sciences makes antiviral medicines, above all for HIV, as well as drugs for liver disease and cancer.
customers: Patients through pharmacies, hospitals, insurers and government programmes.
money: Biktarvy, Descovy and the twice-yearly injection lenacapavir
moat: The leading HIV franchise, with patents and long-acting products that keep patients on its treatments.
opportunities: Gross margin of 79% with an HIV franchise that is the standard of care worldwide
Its long-acting HIV prevention injection expands treatment into prevention, a much larger population
Operating margin of 34% before one-off charges
watch: HIV portfolio revenue and the uptake of its long-acting prevention medicine.
